thread:
lia: Postmortem follow-up for the repeated page clusters Friday night. Need owners for three small experiments: dynamic thresholds, per-tenant dedupe, and paging policy split (soft vs hard). Keep updates here and add PRs to the tracker.
otto: I can take dynamic thresholds. Plan: build a p95-based adaptive threshold that adds headroom during expected spikes and tightens when baseline is stable. Quick prototype using the last 30d window. ETA: 6 business days.
maria: I'll own per-tenant dedupe/grouping. Idea: dedupe by (tenant_hash, service, error_code) with a sliding 30s window and an opt-out tag for high-signal alerts. ETA: 5 days.
infra-bot: Incident 2025-06-11: clustered-pagers-2025-06-11 \u2014 289 pages in 4h. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-06-11-clustered (auto-attached).
devops: I'll draft the soft/hard paging matrix and the canary plan (start with 3 non-critical services, then 10%, then 50%). Will also list rollback criteria. ETA: 8 days.
otto: Prototype query I'm using to compute adaptive thresholds:
```promql
# compute p95 across last 30d, add 2x headroom for spikey services
baseline = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[30d])) by (le, service))
adaptive_threshold = max(baseline * 2, baseline + 0.01)
```
maria: Dedupe template I'll test in staging:
```yaml
alert: tenant-error-flood
expr: sum by(tenant_hash, service, error_code) (rate(errors_total[1m]))
for: 2m
dedupe_key: "{{tenant_hash}}:{{service}}:{{error_code}}"
dedupe_window: 30s
labels:
  allow_high_signal: "false"
```
lia: Nice. Please add a short note in the tracker explaining risk (false-suppressions) and rollback steps (disable dedupe or tag opt-out). Tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-tuning-tracker.
devops: For the paging matrix, I propose: channel-only for non-SLA errors and informational alerts; on-call page for Sev0/1 and SLA-impacting errors; auto-escalate after 10m with a secondary rota. Will include a table of example alerts.
otto: One more thought: we could run an ML anomaly model to flag patterns that look like retry loops and only page on anomaly+threshold. I'll prototype a simple z-score detector as a follow-on if adaptive thresholds don't cut it.
maria: I'll put PR for dedupe rules to staging tomorrow and tag @lia and @devops for review. Will include a short test plan and example logs.
infra-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync 2025-06-14 09:00 PST. Agenda added: alert-tuning follow-ups.
devops: I'll draft the canary runbook and include success criteria: < 10% change in total pages and zero missed SLA alerts in 48h for canary services. Rollback if fail.
lia: Good. Please add JIRA tickets for each action (adaptive-thresholds, per-tenant-dedupe, paging-matrix) and link them in the tracker. We'll mark risk level and owners.
otto: Putting a small branch for adaptive thresholding up by EOD and will post link.
maria: PR created: staging/dedupe/tenant-30s. Will ping when CI passes.
devops: Drafted paging matrix doc, uploading now.
lia: Thanks all. We'll close items after the canary review and a 7-day post-rollout check for regressions. If anyone sees anomalies during rollout, post here immediately and we'll revert. :thumbsup:
